invariants.assert: Sealed authority is distinct from current effective capability.
Recorded is the safe floor and can never imply verifiability.
The orchestration host, not evidence producers, owns custody selection.
Durable authority requires an explicit project storage and retention policy.
Resolve, pin, lease, purge, expiry, release, retry, and reclaim obey the typed reducer in one project-ledger transaction.
A live HELD lease blocks intersecting purge and defers intersecting expiry.
Crash reclaim requires dead-owner evidence and an expired fencing sequence.
Idempotent retry never changes pins, fencing, or expiry.
Purge output is a complete derived partition, never a trusted label.
D9 rows carry every closed input axis and the complete derived termination payload plus exit code.
Every direct and transitive proof reference has exactly one typed custody owner at its exact minimum.
A partially unavailable custody unit confers none of that unit capability.
Run, unit, object, pin, purge, and lineage identity are ProjectId-scoped; equal digests never alias projects.
This authoring candidate cannot accept product state, close dependencies, or apply integration state.
The contract and owned checkers are recursively closed and total over parsed JSON values.
